sections.title: 58:3-4 wording revised between the 1989 and 1992 editions
sections.summary: The English wording of 58:3-4 was substantially revised between the 1989 and 1992 editions. 1989 reading begins "Those who estrange their wives in this manner, then reconcile there after, shall atone by freeing a slave befo...". 1992 final reading begins "Those who estrange their wives in this manner, then reconcile thereafter, shall atone by freeing a slave befor...". Machine comparison candidate; 1981 and 1989 readings are page-transcription extractions that need review.
